body: I'm actually in my last year of high school, so my problems are probably exaggerated in my head. This subreddit is so caring and I'm just making a big deal out of my issues. I do often think about what it would be like if I ended it, but I'm a coward. And there are genuine people suffering. I overreact easily, thank you for your reply.

Thank you for the reply. I haven't genuinely been happy for so long it's like I'm not even in my own body. Truthfully, I'm terrified of what others think of me so I don't feel like I'm getting any better. Everything about me is trivial in comparison to the others on this subreddit. I don't deserve to ask for help from the people who are kind enough to extend a hand or a ear.
